instruction: Save the raw image as an EXR file with 32-bit float precision.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because standard GIMP installations do not support EXR format export, and even if supported via plugins, verifying the specific bit depth (32-bit float) would require specialized file analysis.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP does not natively support EXR format export without plugins
Verification requirements are beyond current framework capabilities - would require specialized file analysis to verify 32-bit float precision in EXR headers
